trigger: Plays upon entering the municipal Render Farm server towers.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Render Farm. Megawatts of boiling coolant hum under infinite templating.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: 94 degrees Celsius?! The coolant is boiling my Sprite! The CPUs are melting!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, smells like burned silicon and bad management decisions. Tragic drip.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Lann, look at the lighting in here! Flat, fluorescent corporate filth!

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Sehaj's render bay is past those exhaust fans. We have to hurry, dost!
